description: Search historical newspaper pages in the Chronicling America corpus. Returns matching pages with the opening of each page's OCR text (~500 characters), publication title, date, the states LOC indexes the title under, and the page URL needed for libofcongress_get_newspaper_page. Filters by keyword, date range, US state, and newspaper title. The excerpt is the page's first lines, not the text around the match: to read where the query occurs, call libofcongress_get_newspaper_page with the returned url field and this query as its match, which returns the passages around each occurrence; omit match for the full page text. OCR quality varies: 19th-century and degraded materials may contain fragmented or garbled text.

date_end.description: End of the date filter, inclusive, in the same forms as date_start (e.g., 1920 or "1912-04-16"). A year or month ends on its last day, so "1912-04" runs through April 30. Omit to run through the current year.

date_start.description: Start of the date filter, inclusive: an integer year (e.g., 1900) or a "YYYY", "YYYY-MM", or "YYYY-MM-DD" string (e.g., "1912-04-15"); month and day may be one or two digits. A year or month starts on its first day. Omit for no lower bound.

limit.description: Results per page. Default 25. A page holds at most 100 results: a larger limit (up to 1000) is served as a 100-result page, and page then counts 100-result pages.

newspaper_title.description: Filter to one newspaper. Pass the newspaper_title value of a libofcongress_search_newspapers result exactly (case-insensitive), e.g., "new-york tribune (new york [n.y.]) 1866-1924" — the full catalog title with place and run. A shortened title such as "New-York Tribune" matches nothing.

query.description: Keyword search across OCR text and newspaper metadata.

state.description: Filter to newspapers LOC indexes under this US state: the full state name (e.g., "oklahoma", "new york") or its two-letter postal code (e.g., "OK", "NY"), case-insensitive. Use "district of columbia" (or "DC") for Washington, D.C.; "washington" means Washington state. City and county names match nothing.

name: libofcongress_search_newspapers

effectiveLimit.description: The page size actually served when limit exceeded the per-call cap of 100. Absent when limit was within the cap.

effectiveQuery.description: The keyword query as submitted to the Chronicling America API, after trimming.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date`: date_start or date_end names no calendar day: a month outside 01-12, or a day past the end of its month (e.g., "1912-02-30"). `invalid_date_range`: date_start is later than date_end, or date_start is given alone and is later than the current year. `rate_limit_exceeded`: LOC API rate limit exceeded; requests are blocked for approximately 1 hour. `server_busy`: More Library of Congress requests are queued on this server than can start within this call's time budget. `request_timed_out`: The Library of Congress did not respond within the 50-second request budget. `upstream_unavailable`: The Library of Congress could not be reached, or answered with an error status, a bot challenge or other HTML page, or an unreadable response instead of its JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next.description: True when a retrievable next page follows this one. Never promises a page past LOC's ~100,000-item retrieval ceiling.

items.description: Newspaper page results matching the search query and filters.
A single newspaper page search result.

description.description: Opening of the page's OCR text (~500 chars): the page's first lines, not the text around the match. Pass the query as match to libofcongress_get_newspaper_page for the passages around it.

newspaper_title.description: The newspaper's full catalog title with place and run (e.g., "the seattle star (seattle, wash.) 1899-1947"). Pass it unchanged as newspaper_title to search only this paper.

states.description: Every US state LOC indexes this newspaper title under (e.g., ["georgia", "south carolina"]), in LOC order. A title indexed against its circulation area lists several, so no entry is necessarily the place of publication — libofcongress_get_newspaper_page returns place_of_publication. Absent when LOC lists no state.

url.description: LOC resource URL for this page — pass to libofcongress_get_newspaper_page for its full OCR text, or with the query as match for the passages around it.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty or a page is out of range — echoes applied filters and suggests how to broaden — plus disclosure of a capped limit or of the retrieval ceiling. Absent on ordinary result pages.

pages.description: Total retrievable pages. For result sets larger than LOC will page through (~100,000 pages) this is capped, and a notice discloses how to reach the rest (partition by date/state).

total.description: Total number of matching newspaper pages in the result set.

totalCount.description: Total matching newspaper pages — mirrors output.total for agent reasoning.

title: Search Historical Newspapers
